newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Govt has strategy to reduce rates - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Govt has strategy to reduce rates - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday the Liberal-National government had a strategy in place to reduce interest rates.
"The government has a strategy in place to reduce interest rates," Costello told parliament.
"We have already seen in relation to the differential between the 10-year U.S. bond and the 10-year Australian bond, a decline of 130 basis points since we were elected," he said.
The Reserve Bank of Australia cut official cash rates by 0.5 points to 7.0 percent on July 31 and many private sector economists expect a futher cut by the end of the year.
Prime Minister John Howard's Liberal-National administration was elected in March, ending 13 years of Labor Party rule.
It has slashed government spending and plans sweeping labour market reforms as part of an economic strategy which it says will help ease pressure on interest rates.
